api: change imports com.itextpdf.text.* to org.openpdf.text.* (Document, Paragraph, PdfWriter, PdfPTable keep their names)
msg: iText 5 (com.itextpdf:itextpdf) is AGPLv3: iText states that iText 5 and all later versions are dual-licensed AGPLv3 or commercial. Replace with OpenPDF 3.0.5 (LGPL 2.1 / MPL 2.0).

api: split by job: page generation to OpenPDF, reading, form filling and signing to org.apache.pdfbox:pdfbox:3.0.8
msg: The iText Core bundle pulls in every AGPLv3 iText module (kernel, io, layout, forms, sign, pdfa and more). Replace the bundle with the one library each job needs.

api: PdfDocument + PdfWriter become org.openpdf.text.Document + org.openpdf.text.pdf.PdfWriter; for reading or editing existing PDFs use org.apache.pdfbox:pdfbox:3.0.8 (PDDocument)
msg: iText kernel (com.itextpdf:kernel) is the AGPLv3 core every other iText module depends on. Replace with OpenPDF 3.0.5 to write PDFs, or Apache PDFBox 3.0.8 (Apache 2.0) to read and edit them.

api: Paragraph, Table and Cell become org.openpdf.text.Paragraph and org.openpdf.text.pdf.PdfPTable / PdfPCell
msg: iText layout (com.itextpdf:layout) is AGPLv3. Replace with OpenPDF 3.0.5, which keeps the Document / Paragraph / PdfPTable model.

api: fonts and images move to org.openpdf.text.pdf.BaseFont and org.openpdf.text.Image
msg: iText io (com.itextpdf:io) is AGPLv3 and only exists to serve iText kernel. Remove it together with kernel; OpenPDF 3.0.5 carries its own font and image classes.
iText forms (com.itextpdf:forms) is AGPLv3. Fill and flatten AcroForms with Apache PDFBox 3.0.8 (Apache 2.0) instead.

api: PdfSigner becomes PDDocument.addSignature(PDSignature, SignatureInterface) with your own CMS signer
msg: iText sign (com.itextpdf:sign) is AGPLv3. Apache PDFBox 3.0.8 signs PDFs through PDSignature and a SignatureInterface you implement (for example with Bouncy Castle).

api: write PDF/A with PDFBox (XMP metadata + OutputIntent) and validate the result with org.apache.pdfbox:preflight:3.0.8
msg: iText pdfa (com.itextpdf:pdfa) is AGPLv3. Build PDF/A output with Apache PDFBox 3.0.8 and check conformance with PDFBox Preflight 3.0.8.

api: HtmlConverter.convertToPdf(html, out) becomes a Flying Saucer style renderer on OpenPDF (openpdf-html 3.0.5, or org.xhtmlrenderer:flying-saucer-pdf 10.5.0)
msg: iText pdfHTML (com.itextpdf:html2pdf) is an AGPLv3 add-on. Render HTML to PDF with openpdf-html 3.0.5 on top of OpenPDF instead.

api: BarcodeQRCode / Barcode128 move to org.openpdf.text.pdf.Barcode128 and BarcodePDF417
msg: iText barcodes (com.itextpdf:barcodes) is AGPLv3. OpenPDF 3.0.5 ships Barcode128, BarcodeEAN and BarcodePDF417.

api: these modules only serve iText kernel and layout; remove them in the same commit
msg: This iText support module is AGPLv3 and has no job once kernel and layout are gone. Remove it with them.

api: depend on org.bouncycastle directly if your PDFBox signer needs it
msg: The iText Bouncy Castle adapter is AGPLv3 and exists only for iText sign. Remove it when sign goes.

api: no drop-in open replacement: decide per feature (drop it, rebuild it on PDFBox, or keep a commercial iText licence for this module only)
msg: This com.itextpdf add-on is sold under AGPLv3 or commercial terms and has no one-line open replacement.

api: com.itextpdf.text.* becomes org.openpdf.text.*; com.itextpdf.kernel / layout become OpenPDF or PDFBox classes
msg: Java or Kotlin source still imports com.itextpdf: this line breaks the build once the iText dependency is removed.

api: delete it after the last com.itextpdf dependency is replaced, or it keeps inviting iText back
